title: BODYinTRANSIT-Lab: A Multimodal Dataset for Investigating Sensory-Driven Transformations in Body Perception and Affective Experiences
abstract: arXiv:2611.14093v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal datasets that combine synchronised behavioural and physiological signals with subjective affective and body perception measures are still rare. This limits both the understanding of embodied experience and the development of computational models that infer subjective states from sensor data. We introduce BODYinTRANSIT-Lab, a multimodal dataset that addresses this gap by capturing affective, perceptual, and behavioural responses to the Footsteps Illusion. In this closed-loop paradigm, participants perform walking tasks while receiving real-time manipulated auditory feedback of their own footsteps intended to alter perceived body weight. The dataset comprises synchronised recordings from 101 participants recruited through systematic stratification by eating-disorder symptomatology and physical activity level. translated_title: BODYinTRANSIT-Lab：一个用于研究感觉驱动的身体知觉与情感体验转变的多模态数据集
translated_abstract: 将同步的行为与生理信号和主观情感及身体知觉测量相结合的多模态数据集仍然十分稀缺。这既限制了对具身体验的理解，也限制了从传感器数据推断主观状态的计算模型的发展。我们推出了BODYinTRANSIT-Lab，这是一个填补该空白的多模态数据集，通过捕捉参与者对脚步错觉的情感、知觉和行为反应来构建。在这一闭环范式中，参与者在执行行走任务的同时，接收对自身脚步声进行实时操纵的听觉反馈，旨在改变其感知到的身体重量。该数据集包含101名参与者的同步记录，参与者通过按饮食失调症状和身体活动水平进行的系统分层招募。BODYinTRANSIT-Lab将全身运动学与肌电图、心电图、呼吸以及皮电活动相结合。
tldr: 该论文推出了BODYinTRANSIT-Lab多模态数据集，通过脚步错觉闭环范式采集101名分层招募参与者的全身运动学、多种生理信号及主观情感与身体知觉数据，用于研究感觉驱动的身体知觉转变并支持从传感器数据推断主观状态的计算模型开发。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BODYinTRANSIT-Lab, a multimodal dataset capturing synchronised full-body kinematics, physiological signals, and subjective affective and body-perception measures from 101 stratified participants experiencing the Footsteps Illusion in a closed-loop walking paradigm, enabling the study of sensory-driven body perception transformations and the development of computational models inferring subjective states from sensor data.
